SipBuddy 1.1.0 adds personal photo avatars. Open **My buddy**, choose a PNG/JPEG/WebP photo, frame your face, pick a cartoon or natural-photo treatment, customize the outfit and name, and click **Use my avatar**. Reminders now display your own animated buddy. New users start with a neutral character; the original demo is optional.

Photo conversion and storage are local. No photo upload, AI API, account, or cloud sync is used. This is a stylized photo portrait on an animated cartoon body, not AI-generated full-body artwork. The website preview and Windows app store avatars separately. **Remove my photo** deletes the stored portrait without resetting water history or reminder timing.

Download **SipBuddy-Setup-1.1.0.exe** below (Windows x64, per-user). Existing profiles migrate without losing history; their original avatar remains selected until changed. Install over the existing version to retain preferences.

The installer is **unsigned** and can trigger Windows SmartScreen / unknown-publisher warnings. Automated checks cover input validation, legacy migration, persistence, private photo processing, browser upload/delete flows, and the actual Electron overlay using the chosen photo. Hands-on mixed-DPI, click-through over other Windows applications, and update/uninstall acceptance checks remain documented in the README.
